name: Nathan
summary: A prophet who brought the LORD's words to King David. He told David of God's promise, rebuked him over Uriah and Bathsheba, and helped make Solomon king.

key_moments.title: God's Promise to David
key_moments.description: David wanted to build a house for the ark of God. That night the LORD told Nathan that David's son would build it, and that David's house and kingdom would be established forever.

key_moments.title: The Rich Man and the Lamb
key_moments.description: Nathan told David about a rich man who took a poor man's only little lamb. When David grew angry at the man, Nathan told him he was that man, and David confessed that he had sinned against the LORD.

key_moments.title: Solomon Made King
key_moments.description: When Adonijah set himself up as king, Nathan sent Bathsheba to remind David of his promise, then came in to the king himself. David had Nathan and Zadok anoint Solomon king at Gihon.
